subject: [RFC PATCH 13/57] mm/collapse: revalidate a round against the VMA

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch revalidates a round against the VMA (memory area) in the Linux kernel's memory management system. It checks that the mm is not exiting and has not had THP (Transparent Huge Pages) disabled, and that the VMA still allows every provisioned candidate. The patch also finds the PTE table again to ensure it hasn't changed since the scan and allocation dropped the mmap_lock. If a VMA shrank or was replaced by a smaller one, candidates that no longer fit within its window are dropped. Finally, the patch settles the batch's span for the invalidate operation.
